scope: Process memory native contracts; consumed engine HeapStatistics and nullable allocator accessor written but unbuilt/unvalidated. Guest memory APIs and broader profiler/reporting interfaces remain incomplete.

sourceReview.scope: Source-only owning-layer memory review; no backend implementation, build or runtime proof
findings: Current State.externalBytes only counts explicit ExternalMemoryAccounter users; native BackingStore and ordinary engine buffers are not a complete unified owner account
Original NodeArrayBufferAllocator tracks actual Allocate/Free/RegisterPointer/UnregisterPointer lifetime, not arbitrary buffer view lengths
SM ClassInfo combines ordinary object element storage with ArrayBuffer storage in objectsMallocHeapElementsNormal; cannot equate it to arrayBuffers
SM external buffers are deliberately omitted from standard object memory reporting because their owner must account them
Existing retained native contents may outlive JavaScript detach; a live-object traversal alone would miss those surviving allocations
SharedArrayBuffer standard report apportions byteLength/max among refcount holders; this is distinct from origin-allocator ownership
Raw GC allocation bytes are not RSS or a complete JavaScript/native buffer total
SM CollectRuntimeStats finishes ongoing GC and helper tasks, traverses whole heap and can fail allocation; mapping its result into a void-style HeapStatistics API requires explicit failure handling
malloc_usable_size exists in actual musl mallocng/oldmalloc; current SpiderMonkey recipe disables jemalloc. No zero-returning size callback should be used.
remaining: Design actual allocation-lifetime counters across engine ordinary/shared/native/retained/transferred backings before reporting arrayBuffers/external memory
Define owning-engine heap categories using genuine SM measurements rather than copying V8 values or equating unrelated counters
Preserve worker origin ownership, detach/resize/transfer/GC release, shared deduplication and failure semantics
Kernel rusage/sysinfo gaps remain independent; no kernel/libc or ABI change made
sourceReview.nullableEmbeddingCorrection: The earlier requirement to install a Node allocator before binding the getter was too strict. Pinned env.cc accepts no Node allocator, MemoryUsage handles nullptr, and process.md explicitly permits untracked embedded arrayBuffers=0. Allocation-lifetime instrumentation is required if tracked reporting is introduced, not for a truthful nullable configuration getter.

measurementContract.heapTotal: Actual SpiderMonkey managed engine footprint: allocated GC cells/free capacity/admin excluding known decommitted pages, committed nursery capacity, unique GC buffer pools, runtime/zone/realm malloc ownership and JIT code capacity. Deduplicate per-object slot/element attribution already included in GC pools; exclude ordinary ArrayBuffer and external-string data from this heap category. Engine-specific allocation layout and metadata are included; this is not guest RSS.
measurementContract.heapUsed: Occupied part of the same managed footprint: allocated GC cells/admin, owned malloc blocks and used JIT code, excluding reusable GC buffer-pool space. EVICT_NURSERY promotes all survivors before traversal (also in semispace mode); empty retained nursery capacity appears only in heapTotal.
measurementContract.external: Pinned Node26.13.0 V8 GetHeapStatistics reports Heap.backing_store_bytes(), the external-string table plus ArrayBuffer sweeper credits, not Heap.external_memory() or every registered native C++ allocation. Current native mapping counts actual external-string payloads and ordinary non-detached, non-inline, non-Wasm, non-user-owned ArrayBuffer backing bytes, once per real buffer rather than per view. Shared/Wasm/user-owned backings are excluded from ordinary credits, as pinned PerIsolateAccountingLength specifies. Detachment removes JS backing credit even if native storage survives; physical allocation lifetime and RSS are separate measurements.
measurementContract.arrayBuffers: When a real Node allocator is selected, its actual owned backing allocation accounting across ordinary/shared/retained/transferred lifetimes; no view-length substitutes. When no Node allocator is selected, upstream explicitly permits arrayBuffers=0 for untracked embeddings. This runtime currently uses that untracked configuration.
measurementContract.rss: Actual guest process resident accounting; GC bytes, Wasm reservation and engine heap are not interchangeable
measurementContract.systemMemory: Actual guest AS/DATA constraints via unchanged upstream libuv resource-limit helper. Physical total/free/available are unknown (documented libuv0), RSS unsupported UV_ENOSYS. Kernel fixed sysinfo/rusage values are not used as measurements. No full physical-memory service implemented.

embeddedAllocatorConfiguration.status: Source implementation only; no compile/link/runtime proof
embeddedAllocatorConfiguration.upstreamContract: IsolateData accepts no Node allocator. MemoryUsage reports arrayBuffers=0 in that untracked embedding configuration. Null records absence of that allocator, not a zero-byte allocation measurement.
embeddedAllocatorConfiguration.actualRuntimeChoice: State constructs IsolateData with explicit nullptr; this SpiderMonkey JSContext and native BackingStore paths do not install a Node ArrayBufferAllocator.
embeddedAllocatorConfiguration.implementation: IsolateData constructor records allocator->GetImpl() when a provider is supplied; node_allocator() const returns that stored nullable selection.
embeddedAllocatorConfiguration.trackingGap: No Node allocator is currently selected. Complete origin allocation tracking remains future work; this getter does not claim such tracking or heap/external/RSS support.
sourceLocations: doc/api/process.md process.memoryUsage embedded library arrayBuffers paragraph

nativeBackingAllocationWip.status: Written, unbuilt/unvalidated; not a complete HeapStatistics implementation
nativeBackingAllocationWip.scope: Actual payload bytes of malloc/calloc backings allocated by the engine adapter and released by its own synchronous free deleter. Independent shared native account has no JS roots/State cycle, survives detached/retained owners and uses atomics for background deletion. Count once per allocation, independently of JS views.
excluded: Adopted storage with arbitrary deleters, including original CallbackInfo whose deleter can enqueue a later free
Allocator alignment, metadata, zero-size sentinel overhead and physical/RSS measurement
Complete external-memory measurement or public memoryUsage arrayBuffers result
nativeBackingAllocationWip.reasonForAdoptedExclusion: Original node_buffer.cc CallbackInfo::OnBackingStoreFree schedules CallAndResetCallback through SetImmediateThreadsafe; destructor/deleter return alone cannot establish when that allocation is freed.
nativeBackingAllocationWip.role: Independent actual adapter-owned allocation diagnostic. It is not the pinned external_memory getter and is not required to substitute for its JS backing credit accounting.

libuvMemoryBoundaryWip.status: Written, unbuilt/unvalidated; real constraints, explicitly unavailable physical-memory measurements

semantics.constrainedMemory: Calls the complete unchanged upstream uv__get_rlimit_max_memory helper, reading actual guest RLIMIT_AS and RLIMIT_DATA each time
semantics.freeMemory: 0 means physical free memory unknown per libuv API, not a measured value
semantics.totalMemory: 0 means physical capacity unknown per libuv API
semantics.availableMemory: Delegates to unknown free-memory result; no physical availability inferred from address-space limits
semantics.rss: UV_ENOSYS without modifying output; null output pointer UV_EINVAL

libuvMemoryBoundaryWip.futureMeasurementGap: Kernel getrusage/sysinfo/procfs placeholders and file-cache pages remain unusable as genuine resident/physical measurements; no kernel or libc changes made. This is an explicit implementation gap, not a claimed unavoidable browser/SpiderMonkey defect.
libuvMemoryBoundaryWip.nodeBehavior: Original Node RSS/memoryUsage follows its error path; availableMemory may return the documented unknown0. Module compatibility is not claimed.
libuvMemoryBoundaryWip.resourceUsage: Kandelo-specific guard returns UV_ENOSYS (UV_EINVAL null) without writing output instead of forwarding simulated kernel records. Original upstream function statements all preserved for other platforms; real resource-limit helper unchanged.
